title: Vibrant Citrusy Egyptian Veal Kebabs
description: A citrusy and chewy post-workout Egyptian dish featuring veal, this recipe is perfect for a healthy dinner option, it is kosher-friendly and cooked to perfection on a salt-block using an air fryer.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the veal cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated veal cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated salt-block and cook for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Using the air fryer, cook the skewers for an additional 5 minutes, or until the veal reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the air fryer and sprinkle with orange zest.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
